questions.q: At what frequency will 10 kHz interference appear with fs = 8 kHz?
What does a motor harmonic look like on a spectrogram?
options: A single dot at the hover frequency
questions.explain: The motor frequency changes with throttle.

questions.q: What does a frame resonance look like on a spectrogram?
options: Noise at the bottom of the spectrum near zero Hz
questions.explain: The structure's natural frequency doesn't depend on RPM.

questions.q: The group delay of a PT1 with fc = 100 Hz is about:
Why is a notch preferable to a wide LPF for motor noise?
options: It needs no tuning at all
questions.explain: A deep dip only around the noise frequency and little delay outside the band; an LPF cuts the useful signal too.

questions.q: What can NOT be filtered without losing response?
questions.explain: Low-frequency aerodynamics overlaps the control bandwidth.

questions.q: How do you improve the frequency resolution of a spectrum?
options: Use a longer window, at the cost of time resolution
Shorten the window to a few samples
questions.explain: Frequency resolution ≈ fs / N: a longer window gives a more precise frequency, but changes over time are harder to see.
